authority.note: README.md is the only current Treasury/status document. Do not create dated handoffs or speculative revenue rows.

pools.EARNED_POOL: inference budget funded by paid work, products, bounties, or other revenue

authority_limit: Agents may recommend spend. They do not receive uncapped financial authority.

currency.rule: Record the currency actually received. If paid in another currency, record both received amount and CAD equivalent with the conversion rate used.

rules: MAKE THE CAPSTONE WORK -> IDENTIFY THE GENERIC PIECE -> SEPARATE PROJECT IP -> PACKAGE REUSABLE PROOF -> SELL A BOUNDED SOLUTION -> RETURN A CAPPED SHARE TO EARNED_POOL
Freelance gigs are sidecars: they must never displace Choral Sheep or an academic deadline.
WebGL/product/accessory work is the first-payment scope. UE5/TouchDesigner/Houdini/3ds Max services are not needed to prove the first Treasury loop.
A high-value listing is never mandatory. Owner comfort, truthful fit and bounded delivery are hard gates.
Never package Melodia-specific characters, textures, music, purchased templates, third-party material graphs or client assets as generic inventory.
stop_conditions: a prospect asks for substantial unpaid speculative production
scope cannot be bounded before acceptance
effective pay collapses after revisions/platform costs
reusable-kit work grows faster than actual demand
